# Transition feasibility (generated by sim/matrices.py)

Cell = seconds for the handoff from the row's END pose to the column's START pose: plain number = direct blend is safe; `via X n.n` = routed through a hub; `--` = no safe route. Beat window for a connector is ~0.4-0.6 s; longer stretches the beat. Servo blend rate 170 deg/s.
